name: Fair Duelist Difficulty
summary: Customize health, damage, stamina and enemy attack pressure relative to Story, Fair, Challenging or Duelist. Default: 25% less health than Fair, with Fair damage and stamina costs. UE4SS required for INI settings.
author: oOCamilleOo

file.description: Fair Duelist with selectable difficulty references and numeric health, damage, stamina and aggression multipliers. UE4SS required for INI settings.

changelog: Initial Nexus release, combining the development changes.
Keep Duelist enemy health, aggression, action settings and hidden directional indicators.
Use Fair enemy damage and combat stamina costs.
Rename Duelist to Fair Duelist and correct preset, RPG and Action descriptions.
Support independent customization through the existing RPG and Action settings.
